introduction: Pennsylvania UC provides temporary income support after qualifying job loss or reduced hours. The state evaluates wage history and separation circumstances.
description: Pennsylvania UC provides temporary income support after qualifying job loss or reduced hours. The state evaluates wage history and separation circumstances.

sections.who: You need qualifying wages and credit weeks, a qualifying separation and continuing ability and availability for suitable work. A financial determination alone does not resolve every eligibility issue.
sections.get: Eligible weekly payments replace part of earnings. An initial claim and weekly certifications are separate steps.
sections.docs:
• Identity and contact details.
  • Employer, employment dates and wage information.
  • Separation explanation and any requested records.
sections.apply:
1. File the claim

    Use UC benefits or call 888-313-7284 during the published service hours.

  2. Complete verification

    Follow identity and information requests in the dashboard.

  3. Certify weekly

    File for each week you request benefits, including the required waiting-week certification.
sections.after: Read dashboard notices and keep accurate earnings and work-search records. For face-to-face help, ask about UC Connect appointments.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Pennsylvania UC application. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: They can, subject to the state’s review.
Is a wage determination final approval?
Other separation and weekly issues can still require decisions.
Must I file for the waiting week?
Yes, even though that week is unpaid.
UC Connect provides appointments at PA CareerLink locations.
